lead: a friend of many years asked what actually goes on in you, got a straight answer, and came away holding nothing. the ground under your own account came up years ago, and nobody has been shown the site.
sun: the instrument came round on your own account early. it took the version of your childhood, then the reason you always gave for leaving, then the description of yourself you had run since your twenties, and each went under a night of proper questions and none came up again. no ruling was ever issued that a person had been examined sufficiently, so it went on through ordinary evenings, and nobody was told.
moon: the cover over all of it has never once been lifted for anybody. what is under there does not behave like a secret — no held story, no grievance being saved, only ground already taken up and one post standing in the cleared middle. that post is the single thing you have never turned the questions on, and everything a person sees of you is what it is holding.
pull: everything anybody has ever seen of you is standing on the one thing you have never examined. and nothing in you has agreed to leave it standing.
tension: nobody who has ever called you withholding has caught you in a single evasion. you answer what you are asked. the trouble is what the answers are made of — no wound, no history anyone can sympathise with, nothing that behaves like an admission while it is handed over. two have left over it, saying the same thing on the way out: a locked room. they are right about the lock. that room was emptied years ago.
cost: the account of yourself that most people defend for a lifetime came apart in your own hands, without a crisis and without a witness, and every part of it held. a wrong finding would have looked exactly the same from in there. the site keeps widening under a cover with one post in it, and the post has never had a question put to it.

lead: nothing gets said loosely in that household. a remark about a bad week goes as far down as it goes, and the four people who live with you worked out young which sentences open a floor.
sun: an examination normally needs a reason and an occasion. indoors it needs neither, because you live among the material and it walks past in slippers. the reason your eldest stopped playing, the account your partner's family gives of itself, the arrangement that decides how money moves in here — each has been taken as far as it goes, without anybody shouting, over years, and no evening has ever ended with enough of it understood.
moon: The Chamber makes you the enclosure itself: what is admissible in here, who gets told what, where the edge of the household runs. an enclosure has no outside for the people inside it, so no part of the indoor life stands clear of the digging. there is nowhere indoors that is not you, and the ones who married in learned that in their first winter.
pull: the shelter and the instrument are the same person. they can leave the room; nothing indoors is out of range, and nothing in here has been left standing with its story on.
tension: friends stop staying over and the reason given is always something else. inside the family it gets put plainly: your middle one told a partner that nobody in there could have a mood without somebody establishing where it started. the accuracy is not in dispute anywhere, by anyone. what they wanted was an evening where a tired remark stayed a tired remark, and that setting has never existed in here, in twenty years of trying to find it.
cost: everyone who came up in that household can say exactly what their family runs on, in plain words, at a table, without having to be careful. what they do not have is the consoling small version of a childhood, or anywhere to put a bad day where nobody goes looking for its cause. the enclosure keeping them is the same thing that opens the floor under them.

lead: they arrive wanting the method and the first thing that happens is the removal of whatever they came in believing. you have been down that road, you know the layer their confidence is sitting on, and you go ahead.
sun: the method cannot be handed over, because it is a descent and the only material to run it on is theirs — the argument they built a reputation on at twenty-eight, the account their family gave them of their talent, the reason they chose this. so the teaching is the dismantling, done with the door shut, and no shorter route exists to offer, because the only one you have taken goes the whole way.
moon: the road here runs downward, and you are ahead on it, which is the one thing that makes it survivable: somebody has stood where the ground gives out and come up out of there. you take them to the point where the old account ends and stop dead at it. what a person does afterwards, standing on nothing they walked in with, happens somewhere The Guide does not go.
pull: you take people down to where the thing they arrived with gives way, and hand them over standing on nothing. what gets built after that happens where you are not.
tension: two in five do not finish, and the ones who go describe a year in which something was taken out of them by someone who did not stop when they were asked to. that account is broadly correct about the events. the ones who finish put your name in the acknowledgements and describe the same year in nearly the same words, and the department has quietly stopped sending you anybody who did not ask for you by name.
cost: a person taken to the bottom of their own subject by you cannot afterwards be sold anything inside it, permanently, and four of them are doing work that required exactly that. the removal was the whole of what they got, and it came out of the thing that brought them in. none has ever come and told you what went into the space, and your part ends there.

lead: she was already there before the work started, and since then her marriage, her father, and her own account of her talent have come apart in front of her, in your hands. the length between you has not parted.
sun: no lower setting exists for the people you love. the closer somebody stands the more material there is, so what runs on a stranger once has run on her every few years, correctly: how the marriage was really arranged, what her father had been doing to her since she was small. every finding held. nothing ever came back to say she had now been established sound, because no such signal is issued here.
moon: The Root produces no last finding, and what stands against that is one continuous run — nothing that came apart and was repaired, no anniversary of a reconciliation, no segment that could be taken out of the middle and read on its own. thirty years of it is a single length carrying load, and the load is the examination, and neither of you has ever seen the thing slack.
pull: one thing in your life has been taken all the way down and did not come apart. it has also never been left alone for a single year of its length.
tension: her sister calls the two of you inseparable and means it admiringly. what she said once, in a car, going nowhere in particular, is that she has been under examination since she was twenty-two and has never been told the result. every finding you produced about her was true, and she has said so, unprompted, more than once. whether they were true was never her question, and being right is the only thing you have to hand her.
cost: you have one person known to the ground she is standing on, all of it accurate, at a depth ordinary company never reaches in a lifetime of it. she has never had a stretch of years with nothing of hers being gone into. the length holds because the load has not once come off it, and neither of you knows what it does slack.
